title: Glassy Chip Layer and Border-Preserving Hover Emphasis
description: UI inconsistencies seen on the architecture and technology course site but affecting the UI in general. (1) All chips are conceptually one layer higher than the element they sit on: they need a different, tinted glass background through which the content below stays visible; e.g. on the cards overview the chips currently have the same background as the card. (2) The hover effect currently adds an additional border around an element. This must never happen: emphasis only ever happens on existing borders and on the foreground (text, icon) of a UI element.
